title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Handwritten Text Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating transcription accuracy (Character Error Rate, Word Error Rate, and Word Error Rate-Bag of Words) of Multimodal Large Language Models across benchmark datasets in different languages (English, French, Italian, German, and multilingual) to identify performance disparities favoring English due to training data skew.

Comparing zero-shot model performance metrics on modern handwritten documents versus historical handwritten documents (15th-19th century) to identify performance degradation caused by pre-training predominantly on modern handwriting styles.
